appendix.title: share_url keeps its path
appendix.note: The scrubbed configured URL drops userinfo, query and fragment but keeps the path; a token embedded as a path segment of an operator-configured URL would still ride the admin-only status. Pre-existing (the field was returned verbatim before), narrowed by this diff, and no longer rendered by the panel. Operator-controlled config, admin-only reader, no exploit path.

appendix.title: recorded origin can name an internal host
appendix.note: The stored origin of a test sink (for example a Docker-internal hostname) is shown to admins in Recent sends and the delivery line. That disclosure is the fix's purpose, is admin + human-only, and carries no credential.

appendix.title: generic DELETE covers the new key
appendix.note: telemetry_sharing_last_shared_host sits under the DELETE-open telemetry_sharing_ prefix by design (the reset path); deleting it alone degrades the delivery line to 'an unknown receiver'. The generic PUT still refuses the prefix, so the service stays the only writer.
